v2.modelsHint: Add multiple model services and enable models per workspace. Set separate defaults for chat, agents, quick parsing and reports. Credentials stay protected on this device.
v2.credentialSaved: Saved; leave blank to keep the current credential
v2.credentialOptional: Optional; local services usually do not require a key
v2.sharedConnection: This connection is used by {{count}} workspaces. Changing its address or credential affects those workspaces.
v2.discoverHint: Save the connection before discovering models. You can also add model IDs manually. Save again after discovery.
v2.discovered: Discovered {{count}} items. Review your selection and save.
v2.skillsHint: Import a local folder containing SKILL.md. Its instructions and text references are stored in this workspace and loaded on demand. Importing never executes scripts.
v2.skillSnapshotHint: Each run keeps its selected Skill version. New runs use the saved update.
v2.mcpHint: Connect external tool services. This MCP client is separate from the LanMind MCP server. External writes require approval by default.
v2.stdioTrustHint: stdio starts a local program as your OS user. The program has that user's file and network permissions. Enable only executables you trust.
v2.environment: Environment (JSON; blank keeps current values, {} clears)
v2.trustStdio: I trust this program and allow it to start
v2.mcpDiscoveryHint: Save the configuration before discovery. Only selected tools are exposed to the model. Rediscover changed tool definitions.
v2.trustReadOnly: Grant read-only access to this tool without approval for each call
v2.schedulesHint: Due tasks run in the current workspace while the app is running and unlocked. Missed intervals produce one catch-up run. Scheduled runs are read-only and saved as AI conversations.
v2.runScope: Skills, MCP and authorized folders for this run
v2.allowCreate: Allow creating new files and folders automatically
v2.rootGrantHint: Folder grants expire on app exit or workspace switch. Reads reuse this grant. Changes to existing files require approval and a check for outside edits.
v2.rootRequired: Authorize the folder containing the original file
v2.welcomeHint: Choose a model for a conversation, or enable an Agent to query tasks, organize documents and create local files. Conversations and execution records stay in this workspace's local database.
v2.approvalHint: Review this specific change. Approval applies only to this tool call.
v2.outcomeUnknown: The operation may have executed, but its outcome is unconfirmed. Check the external service before trying again.
v2.restored: The previous file version has been restored.
